descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S09 Line count edges: 12-line recording, 3-line recording, 3-paragraph typed note stored as one entry; full text, no truncation

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Entries display collapsed, each with a line count, and the line count is accurate. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U4 Expanding a collapsed entry shows the correct full transcript: that visit's lines for that patient, all of them, and nothing from another entry. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 AC 4; TFA-92594 How it works 4)
  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given {hospitalPatient}: yesterday's bedside recording of 12 lines (alternating Dr/Pt), today's recording of 3 lines, and an archived 'Encounter notes' row holding a 3-paragraph typed note

When Open the Encounter tab; read the counts; open the '(prior)' row; open the '· Encounter notes' row

Then '(prior)' shows 12 lines and expands to all twelve, first to last. 'Most Recent' shows 3 lines. The notes row expands to the whole note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs. cp1: mustContain '12 lines', '3 lines', '(prior)', 'Most Recent'; mustNotContain L01, L12, QA16-H-NOTE (U3). '3 lines' can only be Most Recent's count: the other rows show '12 lines' and '1 lines', and neither contains it as a substring. A '1 line' or '2 lines' check would not discriminate ('1 lines' is the notes row, '2 lines' is inside '12 lines'). …

Where it ran: dev unit U26; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
